scope: Read-only saved-evidence geometry. No NN/audio inference or reference-guided output/parameter changes. Reference text never parsed; reference counts/DER read only from existing scored records for posthoc failure explanation.

method.centroid: Same existing helper: L2-normalize each measured window, duration-weighted mean, L2-normalize again; exact clean_windows metadata required; duplicate windows counted once.
method.within_label: All distinct measured-window pairwise cosine values; own-minus-nearest-other centroid margins are predicted-label geometry, not ground-truth speaker identity.
method.stage_counts: Native count minus actual merge decisions by stage, minus applied small assignments, then saved final count after smoothing. Eigengap diagnostics do not imply a reduction unless merges.stage says eigengap.
method.short_multimodality: Chronological measured-window cosine matrix, nonoverlap-only pair quantiles, kernel/centered-kernel eigenvalues and connected components at the same global .30..95 thresholds. No requested speaker count enters these calculations; no output labels are changed.

baseline.timing_scope: Saved neural outputs; refiner-only wall time. No whole-pipeline or Android RTF.

short_inference: Main native label has broad, recurring window geometry compared with mono controls; averaging to a single centroid loses that variation. Multiple human voices are plausible, but exact identity/count cannot be established from these embeddings alone; emotion, phonetic content and short-window noise confound. Window-level split is a testable host-only hypothesis, not an accepted improvement.
